notes: Dev ABox revision on lobe_of (subproperty of part_of, with the chain part_of then part_of). The edit moves the occipital lobe from the brain to the lung; it shares no subject or fact with biology-replace-0014 (the temporal lobe to the liver). Related: whether the occipital lobe and the parietal lobe belong to the same organ (composition through the parietal lobe's organ). Derived: the role chain into the organ system (answer), the same chain used in a practical referral (application, all four departments named so no answer is privileged), and a composition with the lung's body cavity. Edit properties for the dev balance: subproperty, transitivity and chain. Unrelated near: which lobe contains Broca's area (the frontal lobe).
